elevations_and_building_sections: Facade System: Unitized aluminum curtain wall & double-glazed low-E window wall systems (U-value 1.3–1.6 W/m²K, SHGC 0.22–0.26) with architectural GRC/terracotta/aluminum sun-shading fins and glass balustrades | Floor-to-Floor Height: 3.4m–3.8m typical apartment levels (3.0m–3.3m clear ceiling); 3.8m–4.2m in villas & ground lobbies | Structural System: Bored cast-in-situ RC piles & raft foundations, C50/60–C70/85 RC shear cores/columns, and post-tensioned RC flat slabs.
landscape_and_infrastructure_plan: Master-planned waterfront/lagoon/park realm, podium swimming pools, retail boulevards, schools & healthcare clinics, dedicated 132kV primary substations, district cooling plants (Empower/Tabreed/PAL), municipal potable water & sewer networks, and multi-corridor highway interchanges (Main Contractor (Phase 1): United Engineering Construction (UNEC - AED 1.9B contract) | Masterplanner: WATG).
parking_layouts_and_allocation: Towers: 1 to 3 Basement Levels + 2 to 4 Podium Parking Levels; Villas: 2–4 private covered on-plot bays | Municipal Parking Ratio (DM/DMT): 1 bay (Studio/1BR/2BR), 2 bays (3BR+/Penthouse/Townhouse), 3–4 bays (Villas) + 1 bay per 45–50 sq.m. commercial GLA | Estimated Total Parking Bays: 1.25 to 1.8 bays per residential unit across 7,000+ units.
